content: paraseq 0.6.3 (MIT, MSRV not stated): parallel FASTA/FASTQ parser, NOT rayon - uses crossbeam-channel plus its own ThreadPool and a ParallelProcessor callback trait; gzip via niffler as transparent (appears serial) input step; callback ownership model conflicts with rustkmer's worker-owned partition tables; niffler was explicitly removed from rustkmer before due to zstd issues.
